chapter.verse: Judah gam panin mi kimkhatte hong pai uh a, “Note in Moses’ Thukham bangin vun na at kei uh leh, gupna na ngah kei ding uh hi,” ci-in ute naute kiangah a gen uh hi.

Paul leh Barnabas in tua mite tawh tampi a kinial, a kiseel khit uh ciangin Paul, Barnabas leh adang thu-um kimkhatte tua thu kikum dingin Jerusalem khua-ah a om sawltakte leh pawlpi upate’ kiangah a paisak uh hi.
Pawlpite in amau lampi-ah kha-in, Paul leh Barnabas in Foenisia leh Samaria gam lam a tawn uh a, Gentailte kiheina thu a zaksak uh ciangin ute naute in nakpi-in a lungdam uh hi.
Amaute Jerusalem khua a tun’ uh ciangin pawlpi leh sawltakte leh upate in a tungsak uh a, amau tungah Pasian hihna thu khempeuh a zasak uh hi.
Farisai pawl lakah a um kimkhat in a ding uh a, “Gentailte in vun at a, Moses’ Thukham a zuih na’ng uh thu hilh ding a kilawm hi,” a ci uh hi.
Sawltakte leh upate in tua thu vaihawm dingun a kikhawm uh hi.

A tampi mah a kiseel khit uh ciangin Piter in ding a, thu a gen-inah: “Ute naute aw, Topa Pasian in a masa-in note lak pan keima kam tawh Gentailte in Lungdamna Thu za uh a, a up nadingun hong teel na thei uh hi.
Lungsim a thei Pasian in Kha Siangtho kote hong piak mah bangin amaute kiangah pia-in,
amaute leh eimaute atuam atuam khen loin upna tawh, amaute lung sungah siangthosakin amau ading teci a pang hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, eite ahi zongin, i pu i pate ahi zongin, a puak zawh loh hakkol nungzuite’ ngawng tungah suan dingin bang hangin Pasian na ze-et uh hiam?
I Topa Zeisu’ hehpihna bek tawh tua mite in gupna a ngah khit mah bangin, eite in zong gupna i ngah hi cih thu i um hi,” a ci hi.
Barnabas leh Paul in amaute tungah Gentailte kiangah Pasian in nalamdang leh lim a bawlna thu a zaksak lai takun mihonpite in pau loin a ngai uh hi.
Amaute in a gen khit uh ciangin Jeim in a gen-inah:
“Ute naute aw, kei thu ngai lai ta un. Pasian in ama min ading Gentailte sung pan kimkhat a teelkhiat ding, amasa-in amau kiangah a pai zawh thu Simon in hong hilh zo hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin tua thu in kamsangte thu tawh kibang hi.
Tua thu in: ‘Kei min tawh kiphuak Gentailte leh A om lai mite in Topa a zon’ na’ngin, A nung ciangin ka hong paikik ding a, A kipuksa David’ buk ka lamkik ding hi.
A sia gawpsate zong, ka bawl kik khit ciangin Ka dingsak kik ding hi,
ci-in a cil pan hih thu hong theisak Pasian in a gen hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gentailte lak pan Pasian kiangah hong kiheite bawlsia loin,
milim kihhuaite ahi zongin, numei tawh khialhna ahi zongin, gawl meek kithat sa ahi zongin, si ahi zongin, a tan’ nadingun a vaikhak ding kilawm ka sa hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tanglai panin kikhopna innah Moses’ Thukham Lai Siangtho Nipi ni simin kisimin, khua khempeuh ah thuhilhte a om uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Tua ciangin sawltakte leh upate leh pawlpi khempeuh in amaute lakah, unaute lakah milian ahi uh Barsabbas, a min thak Judah leh Silas teelin, Antiok khua-ah Paul leh Barnabas tawh pai khawmsak leng a hoih hi ci-in a ki-awi uh hi.

Amaute in lai khat gelh uh a, tuate’ khut tawh hih bangin a khak uh hi: “Sawltakte leh upate ahi uh ute naute in Antiok khua akipan Siria gam leh Kilikia gamah a om Gentail ute naute kiangah itna lai tawh kong zasak uh hi.
Mi kimkhatte in ko thupiak lohin kote kiang panin a paikhia uh a, note lungsim uh hong lumletin, hong gimsak zo cih thu ka za uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in Topa Zeisu’ min hangin a nuntakna a paaikhia ka it uh
Barnabas leh Paul tawh ka teel uh mite, note kiangah kong pai khawmsak nading uh ka ki-awi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note kiangah kam tawh hong zasak dingin Judas leh Silas kong paisak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, milim biakna ganhing sa ahi zongin, si ahi zongin, a gawl meek kithat sa ahi zongin, numei tawh khiahlna ahi zongin

na tan’ nading uh thukham sim loh van dang note tungah suat nading Kha Siangtho leh kote in ka ki-awi kei uh hi. Tuate tang le-uh teh note ading a pha ding hi. Na cidam ta un,” ci-in lai gelhin a pia hi.
Tuate a kikhak khit uh ciangin Antiok khua-ah a pai uh a, mi honpi a kikhopsak khit uh ciangin laikhak a pia uh hi.
Amaute in tua lai a sim khit uh ciangin tua noptuamna thute hanginah a lungdam uh hi.
Judah leh Silas in Pasian’ kamsang ahih uh ciangin ute naute kiangah thu tampi hilhin, a lungkipsak uh hi.
Amaute in sawtpi a tam khit uh ciangin,
lungdamna tawh amau in a sawltakte kiangah ute naute a ciahkik sak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Paul leh Barnabas in Antiok khua-ah a om uh a, midangte tawh Topa’ thu hilhin a om uh hi.
Ni tampi khit ciangin Paul in, “Eite in Topa’ thu i hilhnasa khuate-ah a om u leh naute bang ci-a om uh hiam ci-in en dingin paikik ni,” ci-in Barnabas kiangah a gen hi.
Barnabas in Marka kici Johan sap ding a lungngai hi.
Paul in Pamfilia khua panin Marka in amaute tawh kikhen ahih ciangin, tua banga nasem ding nung zui lo mipa pen sap loh dingin a ngaihsun hi.
Tua thu hangin amaute khat leh khat a kinial ciangun a kikhen uh a, Barnabas in Marka a sap khit ciangin teembaw tungah tuangin Saipras gamah a pai hi.
Ute naute in Pasian’ hehpihna sungah Paul a ap khit uh ciangin amah in Silas samin a paikhia hi.
Amaute in pawlpi omsate kipsakin Siria gam leh Kilikia gam sungah a pai uh hi.
